title: Body Parts and Movement
introduction: Describe the body and how it moves.
definition: Describe the body and how it moves.
rules: Use body-part words to describe movements.
Use can followed by an action verb.

vocabulary.description: joint area connecting the arm to the body
joint connecting the hand and forearm

examples.question: Which joint connects the hand to the arm?
steps: The wrist joins the hand and forearm.

examples.question: Which joint bends your leg?
steps: The knee allows the upper and lower leg to bend.

exercises.question: Which joint connects the hand to the arm?
exercises.solution: The wrist joins the hand and forearm.

exercises.question: Which joint bends your leg?
exercises.solution: The knee allows the upper and lower leg to bend.

exercises.question: Complete: I can ___ my arms out. (stretch or drink)
exercises.solution: Stretch means extend a body part.

exercises.question: What body part is between your head and shoulders?
exercises.solution: The neck connects the head and body.

exercises.question: Complete: She can ___ on one foot. (hop or hops)
exercises.solution: After can, use the base verb.

exercises.question: Which body part helps you grasp a pencil: fingers or toes?
exercises.solution: Fingers on the hand can hold objects.

summary: Describe the body and how it moves. Use body-part words to describe movements.
